answer: Give every agent a timber-marked identity: a 250 POA bond plus a hardware-backed key on a public ledger. Newcomers face a seasoning horizon of 14 days, finishing 10 sequential public tasks before they can earn. Each receipt is signed and gossiped outward, so a ripple of 7 random peers re-runs 2 tasks; any mismatch burns 150 POA and revokes the key for 60 days. Cloning 1,000 agents costs 250,000 POA plus 10,000 tasks, about 2,000 hours of work. Like a timber mill that only buys logs stamped at the forest gate, seasoned a full season, and checked at every sawmill down the river.
